name: YouTube Videos
description: Lists every video of a YouTube channel (links, thumbnails, titles) and ships a Verso block — carousel, grid, gallery or list — with include/exclude title filters, ordering and "Load more" or numbered pages. Keyless by default (the channel's full Videos tab, paged; RSS as the last fallback); a YouTube Data API v3 key, when set, is always preferred.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its admin page and its Verso block (in the editor and on public pages). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
Read the configured channel, the cache interval and the keyless-source switch.
Store the configured channel, the cache interval and the keyless-source switch.
Read the YouTube Data API key and the cached video list from the plugin's own settings table (options are readable by other plugins, so the key lives in a wjp_ table instead).
Create/update the plugin's own settings table holding the API key and the cached video list.

Fetch the channel's video list over HTTPS from www.youtube.com (its web client API and RSS feed) or www.googleapis.com (Data API v3, only when a key is set). Thumbnails load in the visitor's browser from i.ytimg.com, not through this permission. Hosts to allow: www.youtube.com, www.googleapis.com.
Expose the admin settings endpoints and the public video list the block consumes.
Add the YouTube Videos entry to the admin sidebar.
